pages.title: Creative flight
pages.text: The Flux Ship is an experimental vehicle without a survival crafting recipe. If you have one, place it in a clear area with room for its hull and right-click to board.$(br2)W/S move forward and backward; A/D turn. Up/Down or Space/Backspace control height. Release the controls to brake and hover. Sneak dismounts.

pages.title: Handling a ship
pages.text: Flight follows the ship’s heading. Looking around does not steer.$(br2)Sneak-hit an unattended ship to recover its item. Ships reload parked.$(br2)Check Controls if bindings conflict. Find a clear landing area before dismounting; the prototype has no automatic landing or navigation.
